en: A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of four young men posing in front of a painted backdrop showing trees and landscape. Two men sit on a decorative balustrade while the other two stand behind them with their hands resting on the seated men's shoulders. All are dressed in early 20th‑century suits with bow ties and high lace‑up shoes. The photograph is printed with a wide white border typical of real‑photo postcards.
